errors.evidence: The plot shows the line starting at a learning rate of 0.00 at step 0, not near 0.1e-6.
The peak of the learning rate at 2.00e-6 occurs at approximately step 100, not step 20. Step 20 would be much closer to the y-axis.

The curve is not entirely concave-down. It is concave-down from the peak until approximately step 800, after which it becomes concave-up as it flattens towards zero. Describing the entire decline as concave-down is an inaccurate characterization of the curve's shape.
